entries.question: Kya aap bta sakte hain konse doctor ko dikhana sahi rahega
entries.answer:
Breast mein gaanth (lump) hone par aapko turant doctor se paramarsh lena chahiye. KGMU mein iske liye aap **Surgery** ya **Surgical Oncology** vibhag mein dikha sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn jaankari:**
1. **Doctor se sampark:** Aap Surgery ya Surgical Oncology department ke OPD mein jakar dikhayein.
2. **OPD Registration:** Online registration anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jakar appointment book kar sakte hain.
3. **Parchi ka shulk:** OPD slip ka shulk ₹50 hai.
4. **Samay:** OPD subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak chalti hai (Somvar se Shukravar).

**Salah:**
* Main aapko koi medical salah ya nidaan (diagnosis) nahi de sakta. Breast mein kisi bhi tarah ki gaanth ko nazar-andaz na karein aur jald se jald KGMU ke doctor ko dikhayein.
* Apni mummy ki purani reports (yadi koi ho) saath lekar jayein.
* Suraksha ke liye, kripya is chat mein koi bhi vyaktigat jaankari (jaise phone number, Aadhaar ya medical records) share na karein.

Aap KGMU ki helpline **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call karke bhi adhik jankari le sakte hain.

entries.question: Parcha kaise banega
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD ka parcha (registration) banane ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon mein se kisi ek ko chun sakte hain. Online registration aur appointment lena sabse behtar hai taaki aapka samay bache:

**1. Online Appointment (Sabse suvidhajanak):**
* **ORS Portal:** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
* **Process:** Wahan apna mobile number daalkar login/register karein. 'Uttar Pradesh' chunein, phir 'KGMU' select karein.
* **Appointment:** Apne vibhag (Surgical Oncology) aur date ko chunein. 
* **Payment:** ₹50 ka shulk online pay karein aur apni slip download/print kar lein.

**2. ABHA / Health Care App:**
* Aap ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) ya kisi bhi sarkari health app ke madhyam se bhi registration kar sakte hain. Iska process bhi ORS jaisa hi hai.

**3. Walk-in Registration (OPD counter par):**
* Agar aap online nahi kar pa rahe hain, toh aap seedhe KGMU ke **Gate No. 2** (Main Hospital/OPD) par ja sakte hain.
* **Zaroori cheezein:** Apne saath apna **Aadhaar card** aur **active mobile number** zaroor rakhein.
* **Process:** Counter par apna mobile number dein, OTP verify karein, ₹50 ka shulk (fee) jama karein, aur aapko physical token/parcha mil jayega.

**Mahatvapurn baatein:**
* **Samay:** Parchi counter subah **9:00 baje khulta hai aur 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai**. Isliye koshish karein ki subah jaldi pahunchein.
* **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath kisi doctor ka referral letter zaroor layein.
* **Help:** Agar koi dikkat aaye, toh aap KGMU ke Gate No. 2 par bane PRO Office ya Help desk se madad le sakte hain.

**Salah:** Pre-booking (online) karna zyada behtar hai, kyunki wahan bheed hone par walk-in mein samay lag sakta hai.
entries.ai_question_translated_en: How will the registration token be generated?

entries.question: Online booking karne pr parcha kaise milega
entries.answer:
Online booking (ORS portal) karne par parcha prapt karne ki prakriya niche di gayi hai:

1. **Appointment Slip Download karein:** Jab aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par ₹50 ka shulk (fee) online jama kar denge, toh portal aapko ek **Appointment Slip** (PDF) generate karke dega.
2. **Print out nikalwayein:** Is PDF slip ka print out nikalwa lein. Yeh slip hi aapka "OPD Parcha" hai.
3. **Hospital mein reporting:** KGMU pahunchne par, aapko seedhe us vibhag (Surgical Oncology) ke OPD room ke bahar jana hoga. Wahan aapko yeh printed slip dikhani hogi.
4. **Token/Verification:** Kuch mamlon mein, OPD ke bahar baitha staff aapki online slip ko verify karke wahan ka local token ya sticker parche par laga dega, jisse aapki entry confirm ho jayegi.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
* **Mobile par SMS:** Booking confirm hone par aapke registered mobile number par ek SMS bhi aayega, jisme appointment ki jankari hogi.
* **Aadhaar saath rakhein:** Hospital jate samay apna **Aadhaar card** aur **mobile** zaroor saath rakhein, kyunki verification ke liye OTP ki zaroorat pad sakti hai.
* **Samay:** Appointment waale din subah 9:00 baje se 1:00 baje ke beech OPD mein pahunch jana zaroori hai.

Agar aapke paas print nikalwane ki suvidha nahi hai, toh aap apne mobile mein slip ko save karke bhi rakh sakte hain aur vahan desk par dikha sakte hain, lekin **print out sath rakhna zyada surakshit aur suvidhajanak hota hai.**

entries.question: How to book appointments for OPD
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods. Please note that online registration is mandatory and there is a ₹50 OPD slip fee.

### Available Booking Methods:
1.  **Online Registration System (ORS):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, and follow the prompts to choose your department, date, and time. After paying the ₹50 fee, download your appointment slip.
2.  **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same flow as the ORS portal to book your appointment.
3.  **SMS:** Send a text message with the format `Appointment <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** You may visit the hospital in person. Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. You will receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### Important Information:
*   **Timings:** OPD hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Parchi Counter:** The ticket/parchi counter closes strictly at 1:00 PM.
*   **Referrals:** Patients arriving from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department they wish to visit.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

**Medical Disclaimer:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.
